Title: alloy: Support process singleton with client callback
URL: https://github.com/chromiumembedded/cef/issues/3615
Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.** 
Chrome runtime got a CefBrowserProcessHandler::OnAlreadyRunningAppRelaunch callback in #3609. We should add process singleton behavior and callback in Alloy runtime as well.
...
> The key components of the process singleton implementation in Chrome are:
> 
> 1. ChromeProcessSingleton::StartWatching called in ChromeBrowserMainParts::PostCreateThreads. This starts watching for notifications from other processes.
> 2. ChromeProcessSingleton::Unlock (with ProcessSingletonNotificationCallback) called in ChromeBrowserMainParts::PostBrowserStart. When the callback is triggered with data from another process this executes the browser startup behavior via StartupBrowserCreator::ProcessCommandLineAlreadyRunning.
> 3. AcquireProcessSingleton called in ChromeMainDelegate::PostEarlyInitialization. This forwards the initialization arguments to the existing browser process and exits the new process.
> 4. ChromeProcessSingleton::Cleanup called in ChromeBrowserMainParts::PostMainMessageLoopRun. 
> 5. ChromeProcessSingleton::DeleteInstance called in ChromeMainDelegate::ProcessExiting
...
> Log messages will be output for applications (like `cefsimple`) that use the default `CefSettings.root_cache_path` value and don't implement the OnAlreadyRunningAppRelaunch callback.
> 
> The original application is launched:
> 
> ```
> $ cefsimple 
> [1205/115549.592018:WARNING:resource_util.cc(94)] Please customize CefSettings.root_cache_path for your application. Use of the default value may lead to unintended process singleton behavior.
> ... (application is running)
> ```
> 
> The application is relaunched:
> 
> ```
> $ cefsimple
> [1205/115604.143861:WARNING:resource_util.cc(94)] Please customize CefSettings.root_cache_path for your application. Use of the default value may lead to unintended process singleton behavior.
> Opening in existing browser session.
> ... (application exits)
> ```
> 
> The original application outputs:
> 
> ```
> [1205/115604.398927:WARNING:alloy_browser_main.cc(167)] Unhandled app relaunch; implement CefBrowserProcessHandler::OnAlreadyRunningAppRelaunch.
> ```

Title: chrome: Support app restart for things like Chromium version downgrade
URL: https://github.com/chromiumembedded/cef/issues/3608
Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.** 
When building Chromium with `enable_downgrade_processing=true` (default value) the app will attempt to restart if a version downgrade that requires User Data changes is detected. This relaunches chrome.exe via RelaunchChromeBrowserImpl (similar on other platforms). 
 
**Describe the solution you'd like** 
Modify the Chromium code to relaunch the app's main executable by default, or execute a client callback for custom handling. 
 
**Describe alternatives you've considered** 
Set `enable_downgrade_processing=false` to disable downgrade. We'll do this as a temporary solution in M120. 
 
**Additional context** 
The same solution might also work for #3561.
